panels.title: HTTP Thread Pool — Incoming Calls vs Limit
Active In-Flight Requests vs Thread Pool Limit
panels.description: Active HTTP requests being processed by Tomcat threads right now. The dashed red line is the configured max-threads limit (400). When the blue line approaches or crosses the red line, Tomcat queues new connections — this is when the runner starts getting ReadTimeoutException and ResponseClosedException.

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate — Web & API (req/s)
panels.description: Rate of incoming HTTP requests per second. A high rate combined with high active in-flight count means Tomcat is spending a lot of time per request (likely DB writes blocking).

panels.title: Runner API Error Rate — /runner/status & /runner/invocations
panels.description: Errors the runner sees when calling Rundeck. ReadTimeoutException = Tomcat thread took too long responding. ResponseClosedException = Tomcat dropped the connection. These map directly to the 'Exception when sending N reports' errors in runner logs.
